title: The first dinner
text: Dinner is served on the floor, because the table is still a rumour. You bought two mismatched plates, one bowl and a suspicious amount of bread. The soup is a little too salty, and you both say it is perfect anyway. Neither of you mentions the chair that wobbles or the spoon that went missing somewhere under the sofa. Halfway through, the candle goes out and nobody gets up to light it again. The house is quiet, the bread is gone, and it is the best meal you have had in weeks.
